{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Strings

|descr= Return number as ordinal number (e.g. 1 become "1st")

|s1= [number, language, isFeminine] call [[BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber]]

|p1= number: [[Number]]

|p2= language: [[String]] - (Optional, current game [[language]])

|p3= isFeminine: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]])

|r1= [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>private _second = [42] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber; // will return "42nd" for English-speaking players</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
private _num1enm = [1, "English", false] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;	// returns "1st"
_num1frm = [1, "French",  false] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;			// returns "1er"
_num1frw = [1, "French",   true] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;			// returns "1re"
_num1esm = [1, "Spanish", false] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;			// returns "1"
_num1esw = [1, "Spanish",  true] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;			// returns "1*" for Portuguese, Italian and Spanish
</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>
private _num1en = [1, "English"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;			// returns "1st"
_num2en = [2, "English"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;					// returns "2nd"
_num3en = [3, "English"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;					// returns "3rd"
_num4en = [4, "English"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;					// returns "4th"
_num9en = [9, "English"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber;					// returns "9th"
</sqf>

|x4= <sqf>private _second = [1, "unknownLanguage"] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber; // will return "1." if language is not recognised/supported</sqf>

|seealso= [[language]]
}}
